name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun’s journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the electronics labs of Seoul National University. He was working on advanced sensor technology when a chance encounter with a racing engineer sparked his interest. Park quickly recognized the potential to apply his technical skills to improve vehicle performance. He started in a support role, analyzing telemetry data for a Korean touring car team, and rapidly rose through the ranks, showcasing an innate ability to understand and optimize complex systems.

His approach to the Sporting Director role is deeply analytical. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making, meticulous preparation, and clear communication. Park's distinctive trait is his unwavering focus on continuous improvement. He believes that even marginal gains, when aggregated across an entire season, can be the difference between victory and defeat. He constantly seeks new ways to refine processes, identify inefficiencies, and empower his team to perform at their absolute best. His move to Team Penske was driven by the desire to compete at the highest level and implement his vision on a global stage.

Park thrives under pressure, maintaining a calm and collected demeanor even in the most chaotic race situations. He believes in empowering his team to make critical decisions, fostering a culture of trust and accountability. His long-term goal is to establish Team Penske as the undisputed leader in motorsport innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible on and off the track.

physical.description: Park is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a distinguished air.
